clauses.title: Purpose
clauses.body:
Foundation platform. Baseline setup + features so builders bootstrap projects fast.
Tailored for AI-assisted dev — non-technical builders extend it via established guidelines.

clauses.title: Domain model
clauses.body:
- **Platform** — the shared foundation (stack, conventions, UI system, docs discipline).
- **Admin** — operator surface under `/backflip/*`. Auth-gated.
- **Public** — end-user facing surface. Open.
- **Admin user** — authenticates via Google. Holds a session.
- **UI system** — shared component library + theme, consumed by all surfaces.

clauses.title: Two surfaces: Public
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-01` — Two surfaces: Public (open) and Admin (`/backflip/*`, gated). Distinct rendering strategies.

clauses.title: Public pages: mostly SSR.
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-02` — Public pages: mostly SSR.

clauses.title: Admin pages: server components reading data directly server-side; mutations go through server a…
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-03` — Admin pages: server components reading data directly server-side; mutations go through server actions. API routes exist only for consumers outside the app (the MCP connector, public config endpoints), not as the admin's own data layer.

clauses.title: Admin scope owns its auth boundary.
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-04` — Admin scope owns its auth boundary. Unauthenticated → redirect to admin login.

clauses.title: Shared UI lives in packages/ui; apps consume, never fork components.
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-05` — Shared UI lives in `packages/ui`; apps consume, never fork components.

clauses.title: Monorepo: apps/*
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-06` — Monorepo: `apps/*` (deployables) + `packages/*` (shared libs/config).

clauses.title: Non-route code
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-07` — Non-route code (components, hooks, utils, contexts, etc.) lives in underscore-prefixed dirs: `_components`, `_hooks`, `_utils`, `_contexts`, `_lib`, … Underscore = Next.js private folder, opted out of routing.

clauses.title: Colocate by scope proximity.
clauses.body: - `L1-ARCH-08` — Colocate by scope proximity. App-wide → `app/_components/…`. Layout-scoped → in that layout's dir. Page-scoped → in that page's dir. Cross-app/shared → `packages/*` (per `L1-ARCH-05`).

clauses.title: Admin auth supports two methods: credentials
clauses.body: - `L1-CON-01` — Admin auth supports two methods: credentials (email + password) and Google login. Google sign-in is allowed only for emails already registered on the platform.

clauses.title: /backflip/* requires a valid session; only the admin login route is public within scope.
clauses.body: - `L1-CON-02` — `/backflip/*` requires a valid session; only the admin login route is public within scope.

clauses.title: Foundation ships baseline + guidelines; features stay generic/extensible, not project-specific.
clauses.body: - `L1-CON-03` — Foundation ships baseline + guidelines; features stay generic/extensible, not project-specific.

clauses.title: Three-level doc system maintained with every code change
clauses.body: - `L1-CON-04` — Three-level doc system maintained with every code change (see project CLAUDE.md).

clauses.title: Credentials
clauses.body: - `L1-CON-05` — Credentials (email + password) login may be disabled per-deployment for Google-only sign-in. The toggle is honored only when Google is configured, so at least one sign-in method always remains. Refines `L1-CON-01` (both methods are still supported; a deployment may turn one off).

clauses.title: Connector access is read-only and opt-in
clauses.body: - `L1-CON-06` — Connector access is read-only and opt-in (owner-enabled, default off); it grants no capability the connected user's role does not already hold.

clauses.title: Next.js 16
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-01` — Next.js 16 (App Router) — unified SSR/RSC + API routes for both surfaces.

clauses.title: TypeScript 5
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-02` — TypeScript 5 — type safety across the foundation.

clauses.title: React 19.2
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-03` — React 19.2 — current, RSC support.

clauses.title: Turborepo + yarn 4
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-04` — Turborepo + yarn 4 (corepack) — monorepo builds; corepack pins yarn@4.17.1 (see [[backflip-yarn-corepack]]).

clauses.title: shadcn/ui, base-mira style, neutral base, remixicon
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-05` — shadcn/ui, `base-mira` style, neutral base, remixicon — themed component system from monorepo preset.

clauses.title: Tailwind CSS v4
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-06` — Tailwind CSS v4 — styling, CSS variables theming.

clauses.title: PostgreSQL
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-07` — PostgreSQL — primary datastore. Runs in Docker for local dev.

clauses.title: Docker Compose
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-08` — Docker Compose — local infra. DB always dockerized; app runs local (preferred dev) or containerized.

clauses.title: Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-09` — Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit — type-safe schema, queries, migrations over Postgres. Lives in shared `packages/db` (`@workspace/db`).

clauses.title: Auth.js v5
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-10` — Auth.js v5 (next-auth) — authentication (Credentials + Google), Drizzle adapter, JWT sessions.

clauses.title: Vercel AI SDK
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-11` — Vercel AI SDK (`ai` + `@ai-sdk/*`) — provider-agnostic AI integration (Anthropic default, OpenAI, Google). Config-driven provider/model.

clauses.title: Model Context Protocol SDK
clauses.body: - `L1-STACK-12` — Model Context Protocol SDK (`@modelcontextprotocol/server`) — remote MCP connector surface, Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 protected.

---
IDs: `L1-<CAT>-<NN>`. Permanent, never renumber. Retire with `[DEPRECATED]`, never delete.

clauses.title: Owns
clauses.body: AI integration configuration: provider/model/key settings under `/backflip/settings`, backed by `ai_config`, plus the model-call layer (test round-trip today).

clauses.title: Route /backflip/settings
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-01` — Route `/backflip/settings` — admin AI config UI. Tabs per provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google). (`apps/web/app/backflip/(protected)/settings/`)

clauses.title: Server action saveAiConfig(prev, formData)
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-02` — Server action `saveAiConfig(prev, formData)` — upserts one provider's config; encrypts the key if supplied; enforces a single default. Admin-gated. (`settings/_actions.ts`)

clauses.title: Config persisted in ai_config
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-03` — Config persisted in `ai_config` (`L2-DB-17`). Keys encrypted via `L2-DB-16`.

clauses.title: Server action listAiModels(provider) + settings/_lib/provider-models.ts
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-13` — Server action `listAiModels(provider)` + `settings/_lib/provider-models.ts` — live model list from the provider's models API using the stored key (decrypted server-side; key never sent to client, only ids/labels). No key / error → UI falls back to static suggestions. (`settings/_actions.ts`)

clauses.title: Route POST /api/backflip/ai/test
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-14` — Route `POST /api/backflip/ai/test` — one live round-trip via the Vercel AI SDK (`L1-STACK-11`) using the stored key, decrypted server-side. Body `{provider, model, prompt}`; response streams the answer as `text/plain` markdown chunks. Settings-gated. (`apps/web/app/api/backflip/ai/test/route.ts`, `settings/_lib/ai-test.ts`)

clauses.title: Test modal
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-15` — Test modal (`settings/_components/ai-test-dialog.tsx`) — pick enabled provider → model (live list, `L2-AI-13`) → prompt textarea → submit → thinking state → response streamed into the same dialog and rendered as markdown.

clauses.title: Providers: anthropic
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-04` — Providers: `anthropic` (default, Claude), `openai`, `google`. Extensible via the `ai_provider` enum.

clauses.title: Per provider
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-05` — Per provider (UI): `model`, `apiKey` (write-only), `enabled`, `isDefault`. (`ai_config` also has `baseUrl`/`temperature` columns with defaults, not exposed in the form.)

clauses.title: Test request: provider ∈ L2-AI-04, model non-empty, prompt 1–4000 chars.
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-16` — Test request: `provider` ∈ `L2-AI-04`, `model` non-empty, `prompt` 1–4000 chars. Response bounded: system prompt asks for a short, well-structured markdown answer; `maxOutputTokens` 800; 60s timeout.

clauses.title: Full API keys never sent to the client.
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-06` — Full API keys never sent to the client. UI may show a masked preview (first 3 + last 4 chars around a fixed dot run; keys ≤8 chars fully masked) decrypted server-side. Stored encrypted (`L2-DB-16`), never plaintext.

clauses.title: At most one isDefault provider
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-07` — At most one `isDefault` provider (enforced in `saveAiConfig`).

clauses.title: Blank API-key field on save keeps the existing key
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-08` — Blank API-key field on save keeps the existing key (no overwrite).

clauses.title: Only providers that are enabled and have a saved key are testable
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-17` — Only providers that are `enabled` **and** have a saved key are testable (filtered in the modal, re-checked server-side).

clauses.title: Test calls never send the key to the client; provider error bodies are never surfaced
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-18` — Test calls never send the key to the client; provider error bodies are never surfaced (generic message only), same as `L2-AI-13`.

clauses.title: POST /api/backflip/ai/test is per-user rate limited: 20 runs / 5 min keyed on session.user.id; …
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-22` — _(inv)_ — `POST /api/backflip/ai/test` is per-user rate limited: 20 runs / 5 min keyed on `session.user.id`; over-limit → 429 + `Retry-After`, no provider call. Bounds cost abuse of the org's stored provider key (owner-gated but otherwise unmetered). In-process limiter (`_lib/rate-limit.ts`, shared with `L2-AUTH-40`) — per Node process.

clauses.title: Unauthenticated saveAiConfig → { ok: false, "Unauthorized" }, no write.
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-09` — Unauthenticated `saveAiConfig` → `{ ok: false, "Unauthorized" }`, no write.

clauses.title: Missing ENCRYPTION_KEY → encrypt/decrypt throws
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-10` — Missing `ENCRYPTION_KEY` → encrypt/decrypt throws (`L2-DB-16`).

clauses.title: POST /api/backflip/ai/test unauthenticated → 401; lacking settings → 403.
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-19` — `POST /api/backflip/ai/test` unauthenticated → 401; lacking `settings` → 403. No provider call.

clauses.title: Disabled provider / no key / blank or over-long prompt / unknown provider → 400, no provider ca…
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-20` — Disabled provider / no key / blank or over-long prompt / unknown provider → 400, no provider call. Provider call failure → 502 with a generic message.

clauses.title: Saving a provider persists model/params; key round-trips
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-11` — Saving a provider persists model/params; key round-trips (encrypt→decrypt) and is masked in UI.

clauses.title: Setting one provider default unsets the others.
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-12` — Setting one provider default unsets the others.

clauses.title: Enabled provider + key + prompt → answer streams into the modal and renders as markdown; provid…
clauses.body: - `L2-AI-21` — Enabled provider + key + prompt → answer streams into the modal and renders as markdown; providers that aren't testable are absent from the picker; failures show a generic error, not a stack or provider body.

clauses.title: Owns
clauses.body:
Google Analytics (gtag.js) on the **public** surface, its operator config under `/backflip/settings` (backed by `analytics_config`), and the cookie-consent gate that decides whether analytics may run at all.

Explicitly **not** owned: any analytics inside `/backflip/*` (admin is never measured), server-side event tracking, non-Google providers. Server-side start telemetry — how many people run the starter locally — is the `telemetry` domain (`/docs/contracts/telemetry.md`); it shares nothing with this one: no cookies, no browser, no consent surface, admin-only display.

clauses.title: Server action saveAnalyticsConfig(prev, formData)
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-02` — Server action `saveAnalyticsConfig(prev, formData)` — upserts the single `analytics_config` row on `kind`. `settings`-gated. Normalizes the measurement id to upper case; blank clears it. (`apps/web/app/backflip/(protected)/settings/_actions.ts`)

clauses.title: Route GET /api/public/analytics-config
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-03` — Route `GET /api/public/analytics-config` — unauthenticated; returns exactly `{ measurementId: string|null, cookieBannerEnabled: boolean, cookieBannerText: string }` and nothing else from the row. `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=600`. `runtime = "nodejs"`, `dynamic = "force-dynamic"`. Never 5xx: on DB error it answers analytics-off. (`apps/web/app/api/public/analytics-config/route.ts`)

clauses.title: Client components AnalyticsGate
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-04` — Client components `AnalyticsGate` (decides + injects gtag.js) and `CookieBanner` (presentational bottom bar, Accept/Decline). Gate is mounted from `SiteFooter`, the only chrome shared by every public page and no admin page. (`apps/web/app/_components/analytics-gate.tsx`, `cookie-banner.tsx`)

clauses.title: Route /backflip/settings → Google Analytics integration
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-05` — Route `/backflip/settings` → Google Analytics integration — third master-detail entry; fields: Measurement ID (plain text), Cookie banner `Switch`, banner text `Textarea`. List row reads "connected" iff a measurement id is saved. (`settings/_components/analytics-integration.tsx`, `integrations-view.tsx`, `integrations-rail.tsx`, `page.tsx`)

clauses.title: analytics_config table
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-01` — `analytics_config` table (single row per `kind`, `kind` unique default `google_analytics`): `id`, `kind`, `measurementId` (nullable text, plaintext), `cookieBannerEnabled` (bool, default `true`), `cookieBannerText` (nullable text), `updatedAt`. Migration `0005` creates it; `0006` seeds the singleton row with the default banner copy, `ON CONFLICT (kind) DO NOTHING` (re-runnable). `db` counterpart: `L2-DB-23`. (`packages/db/src/schema.ts`)

clauses.title: Consent is stored client-side only: localStorage["backflip.consent.analytics"] ∈ {"granted","de…
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-09` — Consent is stored client-side only: `localStorage["backflip.consent.analytics"]` ∈ `{"granted","denied"}`. Absent = undecided. No consent record is ever written to the database.

clauses.title: Consent gate.
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-06` — **Consent gate.** With `cookieBannerEnabled`, gtag.js is not injected and no GA request is made until the visitor clicks Accept. Decline loads nothing at all. Banner disabled + id set → GA loads unconditionally. This is the load-bearing invariant of the domain.

clauses.title: No measurementId → nothing renders and nothing loads, including the banner.
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-07` — No `measurementId` → nothing renders and nothing loads, **including the banner**. The banner exists only to gate analytics; with nothing to gate there is no banner.

clauses.title: Banner copy is operator-editable and ships with a migration-seeded default, so a fresh database…
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-08` — Banner copy is operator-editable and ships with a migration-seeded default, so a fresh database renders a lawful banner with no admin action. Toggling the banner off must never destroy the saved copy (the field is `readOnly`, never `disabled`, so it keeps round-tripping through the form).

clauses.title: Public surface only.
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-10` — Public surface only. GA never loads under `/backflip/*` (`L1-ARCH-01`). Enforced structurally by the mount point, not by a runtime path check.

clauses.title: Public pages stay statically prerendered
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-11` — Public pages stay statically prerendered (`○`). Config therefore reaches the client by fetching `L2-ANALYTICS-03`, never by a server-side DB read in public page or root-layout render.

clauses.title: measurementId is a public identifier, not a secret: stored unencrypted, unmasked in the admin U…
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-12` — `measurementId` is a public identifier, not a secret: stored unencrypted, unmasked in the admin UI, served to every visitor. It is nevertheless validated against `/^(G|GT|AW|UA)-[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)?$/` before storage, because it is interpolated into a `<script src>`.

clauses.title: Once answered, the banner never shows again
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-13` — Once answered, the banner never shows again (persisted choice). Blocked/unavailable `localStorage` degrades to per-page-view consent, never to silent tracking.

clauses.title: Unauthenticated / non-settings saveAnalyticsConfig → { ok: false, message: "Unauthorized" }, no…
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-14` — Unauthenticated / non-`settings` `saveAnalyticsConfig` → `{ ok: false, message: "Unauthorized" }`, no write.

clauses.title: Malformed measurement id → { ok: false, message: "Measurement ID looks wrong
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-15` — Malformed measurement id → `{ ok: false, message: "Measurement ID looks wrong — expected a tag like G-XXXXXXXXXX." }`, no write.

clauses.title: Config endpoint DB failure → 200 with analytics-off payload + no-store.
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-16` — Config endpoint DB failure → `200` with analytics-off payload + `no-store`. A broken database must not break public chrome.

clauses.title: Fresh DB after db:migrate: row exists, banner enabled, default copy present in the admin UI, no…
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-17` — Fresh DB after `db:migrate`: row exists, banner enabled, default copy present in the admin UI, no measurement id → public site shows no banner and loads no GA.

clauses.title: Save G-XXXXXXXXXX with banner on → public page shows the banner; DevTools shows no googletagman…
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-18` — Save `G-XXXXXXXXXX` with banner on → public page shows the banner; DevTools shows **no** `googletagmanager.com` request until Accept; after Accept the tag loads and the banner is gone on reload; after Decline no request is ever made and the banner stays gone.

clauses.title: Banner off + id set → gtag.js loads on first paint, no banner.
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-19` — Banner off + id set → gtag.js loads on first paint, no banner.

clauses.title: next build keeps /, /getting-started, /getting-started/setup-on-digitalocean-droplet* marked ○.
clauses.body: - `L2-ANALYTICS-20` — `next build` keeps `/`, `/getting-started`, `/getting-started/setup-on-digitalocean-droplet*` marked `○`.

clauses.title: Owns
clauses.body:
Admin auth for `/backflip/*`: Auth.js config, providers, session gate, login route, the role-based authorization model (capabilities), admin user management, self-service account, and password recovery.

> **Reading guide.** Grouped by concern (this is the one large contract, so it groups rather than using the flat Interfaces/Schemas/Invariants layout). Each item keeps its permanent ID; kind shown inline as _(iface | schema | inv | err | accept)_. Code cites these IDs via `@spec` JSDoc tags on the owning module (see the `docs-sync` skill).

clauses.title: @/app/_lib/auth → { handlers, auth, signIn, signOut }
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-02` — _(iface)_ — `@/app/_lib/auth` → `{ handlers, auth, signIn, signOut }` — Auth.js v5 (NextAuth) instance. Node runtime (uses `pg`).

clauses.title: Route /api/auth/[...nextauth]
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-03` — _(iface)_ — Route `/api/auth/[...nextauth]` — Auth.js handlers (sign-in/out, callbacks, session, csrf, providers). `runtime = "nodejs"`.

clauses.title: Route /backflip/login
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-04` — _(iface)_ — Route `/backflip/login` — public login page: credentials form + Google button.

clauses.title: Providers: Credentials
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-05` — _(iface)_ — Providers: **Credentials** (email + password) and **Google** (OAuth, `allowDangerousEmailAccountLinking`). Each is included conditionally — Google when configured, Credentials unless disabled (`L2-AUTH-33`).

clauses.title: proxy(request)
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-01` — _(iface)_ — `proxy(request)` — edge gate on `/backflip/:path*`. Reads Auth.js JWT via `getToken` (presence only — the edge can't validate token version without a DB). No token on a non-public path → redirect `/backflip/login?from=<path>`. Public paths bypass the gate: `/backflip/login`, `/backflip/forgot-password`, `/backflip/reset-password`. The "already-signed-in → dashboard" redirect lives on the login page (node, validity-aware), not here. (`apps/web/proxy.ts`)

clauses.title: Auth-mode flags
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-33` — _(iface)_ — Auth-mode flags (`apps/web/app/_lib/auth/config.ts`, server-only): `isGoogleConfigured()` (both `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID`+`AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET`), `isCredentialsEnabled()`. `AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false` → Google-only: Credentials provider omitted, password form + "Forgot password?" hidden, recovery actions refuse. Fail-safe: the disable is honored ONLY when Google is configured, so credentials never fully lock out a deployment. The seeded owner is pre-registered, so Google works for them by default (`L2-DB-04`).

clauses.title: Session = Auth.js JWT
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-06` — _(schema)_ — Session = Auth.js JWT (encrypted cookie). Strategy `jwt` (required by Credentials). Payload exposes `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.name`, `user.role`, and carries `tokenVersion` for revocation.

clauses.title: Env: AUTH_SECRET, AUTH_TRUST_HOST, AUTH_GOOGLE_ID, AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET, AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-07` — _(schema)_ — Env: `AUTH_SECRET`, `AUTH_TRUST_HOST`, `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID`, `AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET`, `AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED` (root `.env.local`). Credentials work without Google vars; `AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false` needs Google set to take effect (`L2-AUTH-33`).

clauses.title: Every /backflip/* path except the login route requires a valid session.
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-08` — _(inv)_ — Every `/backflip/*` path except the login route requires a valid session.

clauses.title: Credentials auth verifies email + bcrypt(user.passwordHash).
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-09` — _(inv)_ — Credentials auth verifies email + bcrypt(`user.passwordHash`). No plaintext compare.

clauses.title: Google sign-in succeeds only if a user row with that email already exists
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-10` — _(inv)_ — Google sign-in succeeds only if a `user` row with that email already exists (enforced in `signIn` callback). No self-registration via OAuth.

clauses.title: Google callback links to the existing user by verified email
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-11` — _(inv)_ — Google callback links to the existing user by verified email (pre-registered emails are trusted).

clauses.title: There is always ≥1 usable sign-in method: AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false disables password logi…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-34` — _(inv)_ — There is always ≥1 usable sign-in method: `AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false` disables password login only when Google is configured (`L2-AUTH-33`). The owner, being pre-registered, can always sign in with Google when it's configured — regardless of whether a password is set.

clauses.title: Google sign-in requires profile.email_verified === true before the pre-registration lookup
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-41` — _(inv)_ — Google sign-in requires `profile.email_verified === true` before the pre-registration lookup (`L2-AUTH-10`); an unverified OAuth email is denied — hardens `L2-AUTH-11` (email-based account linking, `allowDangerousEmailAccountLinking`) against linking via an unverified address. Credentials login normalizes the email (`trim().toLowerCase()`) to the stored form (`L2-AUTH-09`), so lookup/compare is case-insensitive.

clauses.title: Google sign-in syncs the avatar: after the pre-registration check passes, profile.picture
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-45` — _(inv)_ — Google sign-in **syncs the avatar**: after the pre-registration check passes, `profile.picture` (non-empty string only) is written to `users.image` whenever it differs from the stored value, and the same picture is stamped into the JWT at sign-in so the session shows it immediately. Email-based linking (`L2-AUTH-11`) never updates the existing row on its own, so without this a pre-registered user has no image. Credentials sign-in leaves `image` untouched; there is no local avatar upload for this to overwrite.

clauses.title: Missing/invalid session → 307 redirect to login, original path in from.
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-12` — _(err)_ — Missing/invalid session → 307 redirect to login, original path in `from`. No error body.

clauses.title: Bad credentials → Auth.js returns to login with error
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-13` — _(err)_ — Bad credentials → Auth.js returns to login with error (no session issued).

clauses.title: Google email not pre-registered → sign-in denied
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-14` — _(err)_ — Google email not pre-registered → sign-in denied (`signIn` returns false).

clauses.title: Missing AUTH_SECRET → Auth.js "server configuration" error.
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-15` — _(err)_ — Missing `AUTH_SECRET` → Auth.js "server configuration" error. Ensure root env loaded (dev script uses dotenv; docker uses compose `env_file`).

clauses.title: Unauth request to any /backflip/*
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-16` — _(accept)_ — Unauth request to any `/backflip/*` (non-login) redirects to `/backflip/login`.

clauses.title: Valid credentials → session with user.role; protected page reachable.
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-17` — _(accept)_ — Valid credentials → session with `user.role`; protected page reachable.

clauses.title: Google sign-in with a pre-registered email yields a session; unknown email is rejected.
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-18` — _(accept)_ — Google sign-in with a pre-registered email yields a session; unknown email is rejected.

clauses.title: With AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false and Google configured: the login page shows only the Google…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-35` — _(accept)_ — With `AUTH_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false` and Google configured: the login page shows only the Google button, credentials sign-in and the recovery actions are refused, and a Google-only owner (seeded without `ADMIN_PASSWORD`) signs in via Google. With Google NOT configured, the flag is ignored and password login remains.

clauses.title: @/app/_lib/auth/permissions
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-19` — _(iface)_ — `@/app/_lib/auth/permissions` — pure, client-safe authorization model: `Role` (`owner|admin|teammate`), `ROLES`, `ROLE_LABELS`, `Capability`, `can(role, capability)`, helpers `canViewUsers`/`canEditUsers`/`canAccessSettings`. Single source of truth for grants.

clauses.title: @/app/_lib/auth/guard → requireCapability(capability)
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-20` — _(iface)_ — `@/app/_lib/auth/guard` → `requireCapability(capability)` — server-only route guard. Unauth → `/backflip/login`; authed but lacking capability → `/backflip`. Returns the session user.

clauses.title: Capability grants: owner = all
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-21` — _(inv)_ — Capability grants: **owner** = all (`dashboard`, `account`, `users.view`, `users.edit`, `settings`); **admin** = `dashboard`, `account`, `users.view`; **teammate** = `dashboard`, `account`. Owner is the superset.

clauses.title: Authorization is enforced server-side
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-22` — _(inv)_ — Authorization is enforced server-side (route guards via `requireCapability`, per-action capability checks, and per-endpoint checks), never UI-only. Hidden nav items / buttons are cosmetic. Guarded: `/backflip/users` (`users.view`) + `updateUser`/`deleteUser` (`users.edit`) + `POST /api/backflip/users` (`users.edit`); `/backflip/settings` + `saveAiConfig`/`saveEmailConfig` (`settings`).

clauses.title: teammate visiting /backflip/users or /backflip/settings → redirect /backflip; admin visiting /b…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-24` — _(accept)_ — teammate visiting `/backflip/users` or `/backflip/settings` → redirect `/backflip`; admin visiting `/backflip/settings` → redirect. Owner reaches both; only owner sees Edit / Add user on users and can save settings.

clauses.title: POST /api/backflip/users route handler
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-25` — _(iface)_ — `POST /api/backflip/users` route handler (owner, `users.edit`; `runtime="nodejs"`) — JSON body `{name?, email, role, password?}`, validated by `createUserSchema` (`L2-AUTH-42`): email format, known role, and a password that is either blank (→ Google-only) or ≥8 chars. Inserts a `user` row; optional password → `passwordHash` null means Google-only sign-in (email must be pre-registered per `L2-AUTH-10/11`). On success a welcome email is sent best-effort (`L2-EMAIL-11`); an unconfigured provider or send failure never changes the outcome. Status: 201 created · 400 validation · 401 unauth · 403 forbidden · 409 duplicate email. (`apps/web/app/api/backflip/users/route.ts`)

clauses.title: Server action deleteUser(userId)
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-38` — _(iface)_ — Server action `deleteUser(userId)` (owner, `users.edit`) — permanently deletes a `user` row; FK cascade removes the user's accounts/sessions/tokens. Returns `{ok,message}`. (`users/_actions.ts`)

clauses.title: Self-lockout guard: an owner cannot change their own role
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-23` — _(inv)_ — Self-lockout guard: an owner cannot change their own role (enforced in `updateUser`).

clauses.title: Last-owner protection
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-39` — _(inv)_ — Last-owner protection (server-enforced): neither `deleteUser` (delete) nor `updateUser` (demotion from `owner`) may reduce the owner count to zero, and `deleteUser` also refuses self-delete. Both run in a transaction that locks the `owner` row set (`SELECT … FOR UPDATE`), so two concurrent demotions/deletes of the two remaining owners serialize instead of both passing a stale count.

clauses.title: Admin user-management inputs are schema-validated
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-42` — _(inv)_ — Admin user-management inputs are schema-validated (`apps/web/app/_lib/validation.ts`, zod): `createUserSchema` (`POST /api/backflip/users`) and `updateUserSchema` (`updateUser`) enforce email format, a known role, and (create) the password floor, and reject non-string JSON values (no `"[object Object]"` coercion). Owner + capability checks still gate access (`L2-AUTH-22`).

clauses.title: Owner adds a user via the Add user dialog → the row appears in the list; a non-owner never sees…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-26` — _(accept)_ — Owner adds a user via the Add user dialog → the row appears in the list; a non-owner never sees the control and `POST /api/backflip/users` rejects a non-owner call with 403 (`L2-AUTH-25`).

clauses.title: Self-service account
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-27` — _(iface)_ — Self-service account (`/backflip/account`, capability `account`, all roles). Server actions in `account/_actions.ts`, ALWAYS scoped to `session.user.id` (never a client id): `saveProfile` (name); `changePassword` (verifies current bcrypt when a hash exists, else sets a first password; min-8 + confirm; → password-changed email; bumps `tokenVersion` per `L2-AUTH-36`); `requestEmailChange` (step-up: re-verifies the current password when one exists; validates + checks availability + rate limit `L2-AUTH-37`; mints an `email_change` token, sends a verify link to the NEW address — the email is NOT changed yet; requires configured email); `confirmEmailChange(token)` (consumes the token, must match the session user, swaps the address, stamps `emailVerified` since control was just proven, notifies the OLD address, bumps `tokenVersion`). Verify link target: `/backflip/account/verify-email` (protected). Uses `L2-EMAIL-16`, `L2-AUTH-29`, `L2-AUTH-36`, `L2-AUTH-37`, `L2-DB-20`.

clauses.title: Email change is verification-gated: the user.email only changes after the token sent to the NEW…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-30` — _(inv)_ — Email change is verification-gated: the `user.email` only changes after the token sent to the NEW address is confirmed by the same signed-in user; the OLD address is notified on completion. A direct `updateUser` email edit by an owner (`L2-AUTH-22`) is the admin exception and is NOT verified — but it now bumps the target's `tokenVersion` (`L2-AUTH-36`), so their existing sessions are revoked.

clauses.title: A user changes their password on /backflip/account
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-32` — _(accept)_ — A user changes their password on `/backflip/account` (current verified) → sign-in works with the new password + a password-changed email is sent. Requesting an email change sends a verify link to the new address; only after confirming does sign-in use the new email and the old address get notified. Forgot-password → reset link → new password works, and an unknown email returns the same generic response.

clauses.title: Password recovery
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-28` — _(iface)_ — Password recovery (public, `apps/web/app/backflip/(auth)`). `requestPasswordReset` mints a `password_reset` token if the email exists (subject to the rate limit `L2-AUTH-37`) and emails a reset link, but ALWAYS returns a generic success (no user enumeration). `resetPassword` validates the token (min-8 + confirm), sets `passwordHash`, bumps `tokenVersion` (`L2-AUTH-36`), sends a password-changed notice. Both refuse when credentials login is disabled (`L2-AUTH-33`). Pages: `/backflip/forgot-password`, `/backflip/reset-password?token=…`. Uses `L2-EMAIL-16`, `L2-AUTH-29`, `L2-AUTH-36`, `L2-AUTH-37`, `L2-DB-20`.

clauses.title: Recovery tokens
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-31` — _(inv)_ — Recovery tokens (`password_reset`, `email_change`) are single-use + 60-min TTL (`L2-AUTH-29`). Forgot-password responds identically whether or not the account exists (no enumeration).

clauses.title: Token helpers createUserToken({userId,type,newEmail?}) / consumeUserToken({rawToken,type,userId…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-29` — _(iface)_ — Token helpers `createUserToken({userId,type,newEmail?})` / `consumeUserToken({rawToken,type,userId?})` (`apps/web/app/_lib/auth/tokens.ts`). Single live token per (user,type) — minting invalidates prior ones. 60-minute TTL. Only the hash is stored (`L2-DB-21`); consume checks type + not-expired + not-consumed + (when `userId` is passed) ownership, then marks consumed (single use). A failed ownership check returns null WITHOUT consuming, so a wrong-owner attempt can't burn a victim's still-valid token; `confirmEmailChange` passes `userId` (`L2-AUTH-27`).

clauses.title: Session revocation: the JWT carries tokenVersion
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-36` — _(schema)_ — Session revocation: the JWT carries `tokenVersion` (`L2-DB-22`). The `jwt` callback revalidates it against the DB on each request; a mismatch (or missing user) marks the token invalid and the `session` callback drops `user`, so guards treat it as unauthenticated. Password change, password reset, confirmed email change, and an admin `updateUser` that changes a user's email or role (`L2-AUTH-22`) bump `tokenVersion` → the affected user's existing sessions are invalidated (`L2-AUTH-27/28`). Cost: one indexed user read per authenticated request.

clauses.title: Recovery rate limit: requestPasswordReset and requestEmailChange are capped per account at RATE…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-37` — _(schema)_ — Recovery rate limit: `requestPasswordReset` and `requestEmailChange` are capped per account at `RATE_LIMIT` (3 requests / 15 min, by `user_token.createdAt`). Reset silently skips past the cap (no enumeration signal); email-change returns an explicit "try again later". Per-account only — not per-IP (a future edge limiter). (`_lib/auth/tokens.ts`)

clauses.title: Credentials login throttle: authorize blocks after 10 failed attempts per IP+email within 15 mi…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-40` — _(inv)_ — Credentials login throttle: `authorize` blocks after 10 failed attempts per IP+email within 15 min; a blocked attempt returns the generic invalid-credentials `null` (no lockout signal → no enumeration); a success resets the counter. In-process limiter (`_lib/rate-limit.ts`) — holds per Node process (one pm2/container per instance); a horizontally-scaled deployment needs a shared store. Complements the per-account recovery limit `L2-AUTH-37` and the edge rate limit `L2-DEVOPS-22`. Client IP from `x-forwarded-for`/`x-real-ip` (proxy-set, `L2-DEVOPS-05`) — the **last** `x-forwarded-for` hop, the one our own proxy appended; earlier hops are caller-supplied, so keying on them would let an attacker rotate the header and never hit the cap. Assumes exactly one trusted proxy.

clauses.title: Constant-time credentials check: authorize always runs exactly one bcrypt.compare
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-43` — _(inv)_ — Constant-time credentials check: `authorize` always runs exactly one `bcrypt.compare` (against a precomputed dummy hash when the email is unknown or the account has no password), so login response time doesn't reveal whether an email is registered (no timing-based enumeration). Content-based enumeration is already closed (`L2-AUTH-13`, generic message).

clauses.title: The MCP connector's OAuth tokens are first-class participants in session revocation, not a side…
clauses.body: - `L2-AUTH-44` — _(inv)_ — The MCP connector's OAuth tokens are first-class participants in session revocation, not a side channel: `oauth_token.userTokenVersion` is checked against the live `user.tokenVersion` on every request exactly like the JWT check (`L2-AUTH-36`), so password change, password reset, confirmed email change, or an admin role/email edit kills that user's connector tokens too. Connector scopes are exactly capabilities, never a parallel permission model (`L2-AUTH-19`). Every MCP tool call re-checks `can(role, capability)` server-side in addition to token scope — extends the double-enforcement rule (`L2-AUTH-22`) to the connector surface, so a role demotion takes effect on the next tool call without re-issuing tokens. See `L2-MCP-29`, `L2-MCP-34`.

clauses.title: Owns
clauses.body:
ClickUp operator config under `/backflip/settings` (backed by `clickup_config`) — personal API token, default workspace id, enabled flag — plus a read-only connection probe.

Explicitly **not** owned: task/list/comment call sites (none exist yet — this is config plumbing for them), and the OAuth app flow (reserved columns only, `L2-CLICKUP-07`).

clauses.title: Server action saveClickupConfig(prev, formData)
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-02` — Server action `saveClickupConfig(prev, formData)` — upserts the single `clickup_config` row on `kind`. `settings`-gated. Token encrypted when supplied; blank keeps existing. (`apps/web/app/backflip/(protected)/settings/_actions.ts`)

clauses.title: Server action testClickupConnection() + fetchClickupIdentity(token)
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-03` — Server action `testClickupConnection()` + `fetchClickupIdentity(token)` — probe via `GET https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/user` + `/team` (`Authorization: <token>`, no `Bearer`), token decrypted server-side only; returns `{ok, message}` naming the resolved user + workspace count. 10s timeout, no-store. Read-only in ClickUp. (`settings/_actions.ts`, `settings/_lib/clickup.ts`)

clauses.title: Route /backflip/settings → ClickUp integration
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-04` — Route `/backflip/settings` → ClickUp integration — sixth master-detail entry; fields: API token (masked, no reveal), default workspace id, Enabled, plus "Test connection". List row reads "connected" iff a token is saved. (`settings/_components/clickup-integration.tsx`, `integrations-view.tsx`, `integrations-rail.tsx`, `page.tsx`)

clauses.title: clickup_config table
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-01` — `clickup_config` table (single row, `kind` unique default `clickup`): `id`, `kind`, `apiTokenEnc` (AES, `L2-DB-16`), `teamId` (nullable plaintext — a workspace id, not a secret), `clientId` + `clientSecretEnc` (nullable, reserved), `enabled` (default false), `updatedAt`. Migration `0012` creates it. `db` counterpart: `L2-DB-29`. (`packages/db/src/schema.ts`)

clauses.title: Token encrypted at rest, never sent to the client
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-05` — Token encrypted at rest, never sent to the client — masked preview only (`mask.ts`, same util as `L2-AI-06`).

clauses.title: Blank token field on save keeps the existing token
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-06` — Blank token field on save keeps the existing token (no overwrite).

clauses.title: clientId/clientSecretEnc are reserved for a future OAuth app and are never written or read by c…
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-07` — `clientId`/`clientSecretEnc` are reserved for a future OAuth app and are never written or read by current code. A personal token authenticates as the ClickUp user who minted it and inherits that user's access.

clauses.title: The connection probe only reads
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-08` — The connection probe only reads (`/user`, `/team`). No ClickUp state is created or changed from the settings UI.

clauses.title: Unauthenticated / non-settings caller → { ok: false, message: "Unauthorized" }, no write / no f…
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-09` — Unauthenticated / non-`settings` caller → `{ ok: false, message: "Unauthorized" }`, no write / no fetch.

clauses.title: Probe with no stored token → { ok: false, "Save an API token first." }.
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-10` — Probe with no stored token → `{ ok: false, "Save an API token first." }`. Probe failure or bad token → generic `{ ok: false, "Could not reach ClickUp — check the token." }`; provider error bodies never surface to the UI.

clauses.title: Fresh DB after db:migrate: table exists, no row → pane shows "Not connected", Test disabled.
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-11` — Fresh DB after `db:migrate`: table exists, no row → pane shows "Not connected", Test disabled.

clauses.title: Save a valid token → masked preview shown; Test reports the ClickUp username + workspace count;…
clauses.body: - `L2-CLICKUP-12` — Save a valid token → masked preview shown; Test reports the ClickUp username + workspace count; blank-token re-save keeps the token.

clauses.title: Owns
clauses.body: Shared data layer: `packages/db` (`@workspace/db`) — Drizzle schema, client, migrations, seed.

clauses.title: @workspace/db → db
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-01` — `@workspace/db` → `db` — Drizzle client (node-postgres) over `DATABASE_URL`. (`packages/db/src/client.ts`)

clauses.title: @workspace/db re-exports schema tables + db.
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-02` — `@workspace/db` re-exports schema tables + `db`. (`packages/db/src/index.ts`)

clauses.title: Scripts
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-03` — Scripts (root): `corepack yarn db:generate | db:migrate | db:studio`, `corepack yarn init-owner`. Per-pkg: `db:push` too. Migrate/generate/studio via drizzle-kit.

clauses.title: encryptSecret(plain) / decryptSecret(enc)
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-16` — `encryptSecret(plain)` / `decryptSecret(enc)` — AES-256-GCM over `ENCRYPTION_KEY` (sha256-derived). For secrets at rest (AI/email/speech keys, ClickUp + Slack + n8n credentials). Server-only. (`packages/db/src/crypto.ts`)

clauses.title: generateToken() / hashToken(raw)
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-19` — `generateToken()` / `hashToken(raw)` — one-time link tokens: `generateToken` returns a 32-byte base64url random string (the raw token, never stored); `hashToken` returns its sha256 hex (what is persisted + looked up). Server-only. (`packages/db/src/crypto.ts`)

clauses.title: corepack yarn init-owner
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-04` — `corepack yarn init-owner` — seeds/updates platform owner from `.env.init` (one-off file, loaded inline by the seed script; never injected into the running app). `ADMIN_EMAIL` required; `ADMIN_PASSWORD` optional (omit → Google-only owner, `passwordHash` null; re-run without it preserves any existing hash). Role `owner`. Idempotent (upsert on email).

clauses.title: user_role enum: owner | admin | teammate.
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-05` — `user_role` enum: `owner` | `admin` | `teammate`. (Renamed `member`→`teammate` in migration `0002`; capability semantics owned by the `auth` domain.)

clauses.title: user table: id
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-06` — `user` table: `id` (uuid text pk), `name`, `email` (unique, not null), `emailVerified`, `image`, `passwordHash` (bcrypt, null = OAuth-only), `role` (default `teammate`), `tokenVersion` (int, default 0), `createdAt`.

clauses.title: user.tokenVersion
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-22` — `user.tokenVersion` — monotonic session-revocation counter. Embedded in the JWT and revalidated per request; bumped on password change, password reset, and confirmed email change to invalidate existing sessions. Owned by the `auth` domain (`L2-AUTH-36`).

clauses.title: Auth.js adapter tables: account, session, verificationToken
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-07` — Auth.js adapter tables: `account`, `session`, `verificationToken` (standard Auth.js Drizzle shape).

clauses.title: Migrations: drizzle-kit generated SQL in packages/db/migrations/, committed.
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-08` — Migrations: drizzle-kit generated SQL in `packages/db/migrations/`, committed. Dialect postgresql. Applied via `drizzle-kit migrate` (`db:migrate`).

clauses.title: ai_config table
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-17` — `ai_config` table (one row per `ai_provider` enum: anthropic|openai|google): `provider` (unique), `model`, `apiKeyEnc` (AES), `baseUrl`, `temperature` (default 0.7), `enabled`, `isDefault`, `updatedAt`. Owned by the `ai` domain.

clauses.title: email_config table

clauses.title: user_token_type enum
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-20` — `user_token_type` enum (`password_reset` | `email_change`) + `user_token` table: `id`, `userId` (fk → user, cascade), `type`, `tokenHash` (unique — sha256 of raw), `newEmail` (nullable; email_change only), `expiresAt`, `consumedAt` (nullable), `createdAt`. Single-use, time-boxed. Owned by the `auth` domain.

clauses.title: speech_config table
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-24` — `speech_config` table (single row, `provider` unique default `deepgram`): `id`, `provider`, `apiKeyEnc` (AES), `sttModel`, `ttsModel`, `enabled`, `updatedAt`. Migration `0007` creates. Owned by the `speech` domain (`L2-SPEECH-01`).

clauses.title: analytics_config table

Migration `0005` creates; `0006` seeds singleton row with default banner copy (`ON CONFLICT (kind) DO NOTHING`). Owned by the `analytics` domain (`L2-ANALYTICS-01`).

clauses.title: clickup_config table
clauses.body: - `L2-DB-29` — `clickup_config` table (single row, `kind` unique default `clickup`): `id`, `kind`, `apiTokenEnc` (AES), `teamId` (nullable plaintext workspace id), `clientId` + `clientSecretEnc` (nullable, reserved for a future OAuth app — never written today), `enabled` (default false), `updatedAt`. Migration `0012` creates. Owned by the `clickup` domain (`L2-CLICKUP-01`).

clauses.title: slack_app table

Migration `0013` creates; `0014` adds `chromeHeaderThemed`; `0015` adds the custom colors; `0016` adds `chromeHeaderGlass`. Absent row = all defaults; nothing is seeded at signup. Owned by the `ui` domain (`L2-UI-26`, `L2-UI-27`).

Columns `firstSeenAt`, `lastSeenAt`, `startCount`, `activeDays`, `lastActiveDay`, `appVersion`, `platform`, `nodeMajor`, `ignored`.
